name: t106_timing_sec_d1
headline: Human Written
windows:
Timing Is Individual
Most of us need enough Nurturer and Protector first. Otherwise the Guide just overrules your little one in the name of something higher (spiritual bypassing, dressed up as direction). Like a shepherd who’s beating sheep to make them move.

So warmth and safety come first for a while, and the direction can grow once there’s a clear little one in there to guide.
A spiritual opening can come long before there’s much of a Nurturer or Protector around, and it can still be real.

What I’d look at afterward is what it did to your love. Has it reached your little one yet? And does anybody notice a difference, like you keeping your word more, or being more patient when someone’s having a hard day?
